title: La moustache (FCP 2026)
synopsis: “What would you say if I shaved off my moustache?” Marc asks Agnès. Just to see how she’ll react, he shaves off his moustache. She comes home and doesn’t notice a thing. No one else notices, either. Marc stands alone, the only one convinced that until the day before he’d had a moustache. He’s the only one who can see it in old photos. He’s the only one to believe, to see, to remember – he feels like he’s going crazy.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 「如果我把小鬍子剃掉，你會怎樣說?」Marc問Agnès。為了看她有甚麼反應，他真的把小鬍子剃掉。她回到家，完全沒有察覺。其他人也一樣，誰都沒發現。Marc感到孤立無援，只有他確信自己前一天還有小鬍子。只有他能在舊照片裏看見它。只有他仍然相信、仍然看得見、仍然記得——他覺得自己快要瘋了。
